fields.summary_ko.0: ExxonMobil is expected to report Q3 EPS of $3.90 (up 107.5% year-over-year), with results due October 30. Consensus revenue is projected at $102.98 billion, up 21%.
fields.summary_ko.1: Over the next three years, revenue growth is modeled at 1.5%, with net margin expanding from current 9.1% to 12.6% by 2029. Current share price is trading near analyst target.
